nodes.title: You enter the dungeon...
nodes.text:
You make your way carefully into the dungeon corridor. Damp glistens on the walls, and the air is thick with dust. Feeling your way forward, your eyes slowly begin to adjust to the darkness.

“What have I forgotten to pack?” you ask yourself.

Oh well. Too late now.

You continue for perhaps half a mile without a single junction. The corridor gradually widens, opening into cavernous spaces in places, and you begin to realise that you are slowly but surely descending deeper underground.

You stop to rest.

The darkness around you has become thick and oppressive. You pull out a small flint lantern and strike it. A tiny flame catches on the oil-soaked mantle, casting a weak pool of light around you. You must thank that halfling you met in the Wasted Wizard; if you ever see him again, he parted with this lantern for a hot meal.

It isn’t much, but it is enough to see the tips of your boots and a short distance ahead.

Eventually you reach a junction; ahead are some stairs going up, to the right is a door...

Will you A. Listen at the door? B. Open the door? or C. head up the stairs?

nodes.title: Goblin - Kitchen
nodes.text: Three goblins sit around a cooking pot.

nodes.title: Stairs
nodes.text: Cold air rises from the darkness below.

nodes.title: Secret Room
nodes.text: Only accessible if you have the Iron Key.

nodes.title: Troll Bridge
nodes.text: Before you spans an ancient and very unsafe-looking bridge; you cannot really see what is on the other side, but you think you can see a slight glow, maybe a torch? Halfway across the bridge is a lever.

nodes.title: Troll Den
nodes.text: You peer into the dark cave, which slowley becomes wide and forks off into 2 forections. Bones littler the floors and there is the smell of something boiling down the right tunnel.

nodes.title: Junction
nodes.text:
You finally reach a junction after the long corridore entrance which twisted and turned for what seemed a long walk? To you left is a short tunnel with a lit torch and a door. You may inspect the door if you have intelligence above 4.

To the right are some steps, hewn out of the rock, but clearly an ascending route to a higher ledge.

You may...
Listen at the door #
Open the door, turn to 13
Head up the stairs; turn to 27

nodes.title: Introduction
nodes.text:
The Ghost Bell by Tim Sharville

Throughout time or as long as most can remember the bells of Dragonreach have always been a guiding light to the people of this land, not just to meet on religious days and holidays but also as an early-warning of invasion and danger. ome 300 bells are situated in Dragonreach and all are most valued by the people. A selection carefully chosen bell wardens would monitor these powerful and ancient , Tarak the healer is one of the chosen wardens, he proud and honoured to have been chosen.

He would go about is usual duties as a respected medical and spiritual guide to look after not just the people in is ward but in his spare time he would keep and take great care in the bell duties, restoring, repairing and keeping the bells mechanically sound.

One spring morning Tarak is preparing his bags and sachels with herbs and potions to make his visits, he cares a great deal about his local people and they rely on him for healt and spiritual guidance. He always takes stock, sometime very early in the morning, scanning the heavily laden shelves he has built up over the years and is proud of his collection, some items are useless and may seem like powered rubbish to others but mixed or balanced with others these can become so powerful even Tarak has to make sure he gets the mixes just right. Mixing is vital

Tarak has, this morning, run our of one vital herb, the herb Travelling Star
